mods.note: Builder editor. Required on server and client; the builder client pack carries it.
Server side; the client copy is optional. 7.3.8 is the newest WorldEdit for 1.21.1 on Modrinth (2024-10-21).
Block logging and rollback. Server only. 1.3.5 is the newest Ledger build for 1.21.1 (Modrinth, 2024-11-13); it requires Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin. Not launched on 1.21.1 yet.

Library for Ledger. Server only. Newest build (Kotlin 2.4). The old 1.10/Kotlin 1.9 pin was for Ledger 1.2.8 on 1.20.1; Ledger 1.3.5 vs this Kotlin build is untested (fall back to a 1.12/1.13 build if Ledger fails to start).

Distant Horizons, client only (Kort 2026-11-03): far terrain for builders on their own machine, nothing on the server. Modrinth lists 3.3.3-1.21.1 for Minecraft 1.21.1 (fabric and neoforge), no declared dependencies; the pack marks it server unsupported. Not launched in game yet. Indium is not needed with Sodium 0.6 or newer.

Proximity and group voice chat (Kort 2026-11-08). Server and client. Listens on UDP 24454 by default; on Kinetic set port= in config/voicechat/voicechat-server.properties to an allocated port. Keys: V setup/menu, G groups, M mute, N off; push to talk has no default key (chosen on first V). (1.21.1: newest release-type build is 2.6.22; 2.6.23 to 2.6.27 are Modrinth betas.)
Minimap and waypoints for builders (Kort 2026-11-08). Client only, needs Fabric API. Keys: B new waypoint, U waypoints, Z enlarge.
Full world map for builders (Kort 2026-11-08). Client only, needs Fabric API. Key M (same default as voice chat mute).

removed.indium: Dropped for 1.21.1 (Kort-approved 2026-11-08 for 1.20.1): Sodium 0.6.0 and newer implements the Fabric Rendering API itself, so Distant Horizons no longer needs Indium (Sodium 0.6.0 changelog). Modrinth only has Indium 1.0.35 for 1.21 anyway.
